name: Filter
blurb: A dropdown that narrows a list, with the current choice in its label.
mechanism: `<details>` for the open/close state plus one delegated click handler that mirrors the choice into a hidden input. The trigger label is split so "Filter by" stays muted.
caveats: A `<details>` used as a menu announces as a disclosure, not as a listbox, despite the roles on the options.
No arrow-key navigation between options; Tab moves through them.
